```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(devtools::load_all())
step <- pc057_step_begin(params$name, path_target, path_resource)
```

## Tasks

This step copies the archived canonical Figure S2 image; marker trees are not inferred.

```{r}
#| label: run-step
pc057_draw_figure(step, "figS2_terl")
```

```{r}

receipt <- pc057_step_finish(step)
print(receipt)
```
